name: Job ads to company leads – Arbeitsagentur, XING, Impressum

parameters.content:
## Job ads to company leads with legal notice data

### How it works
Builds a lead list of companies that are hiring. **Arbeitsagentur Jobs** and **XING Jobs** search the same keyword and place. **Dataset Merge & Company Dedupe** (mode `companies`) turns both result sets into one row per employer and says in `matchedBy` why rows were merged.

Job ads name the employer, not its website. The workflow takes the domain of an e-mail address in the ad text or of the application link; job boards, applicant tracking systems and free mail are left out. **Imprint & VAT Check** reads the legal notice of each website: legal name, address, register number, EU VAT ID checked against VIES, e-mail, phone. The last node returns one row per employer; `nameCheck` says whether the legal notice names the employer. Employers whose ads carry no own domain keep their row without legal notice data.

Every actor run is charged on your Apify account: per result plus a small start fee per run. The current prices are on each actor's Apify Store page, and `maxCostPerRunUsd` in **Settings** caps every single run. Sites that refuse direct requests are read through Apify's Web Fetch, which Apify bills on your account.

### Setup
1. Install the Apify community node `@apify/n8n-nodes-apify` (tested with 0.8.1; https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation-and-management/) and add an Apify credential (API token or OAuth).
2. Select it in the six Apify nodes.
3. Change the values in **Settings**.
4. Click **Execute workflow**.

### Customization
Replace the manual trigger with a Schedule Trigger and add `listId` to both job inputs in **Build job search inputs** to get only new or changed jobs. Send the final rows to a sheet or CRM.

Independent provider, not affiliated with Apify or the data sources named.

## Search settings
Keyword and place go to both job sources. XING needs a city name, not a postcode. `maxJobsPerSource`, `maxWebsites` and `maxCostPerRunUsd` cap what one execution can cost.

### Charged on your Apify account
`maxCostPerRunUsd` caps every single actor run. Start with small values.

## Job ads from two sources
Both runs must succeed; a rejected input stops here with Apify's message. Each source is charged per job plus a start fee per run.

## One row per company
Rows that share a name at the same place, a website, an e-mail domain or a phone number become one row. Charged per input row plus a start fee per run.

## A website per company
Domain of an e-mail address in the ad, otherwise of the application link. Job boards, applicant tracking systems and free mail are left out. At most `maxWebsites` go to the next step.

## Legal notice data
Charged per website plus a start fee per run. Sites read through Apify's Web Fetch are billed by Apify on your account. `nameCheck` says whether the legal notice names the employer.
